data.title: 宝多六花 · 绚 JUNK SHOP 的柜台
data.description: 【绚JUNK SHOP柜台·放学后】六花靠在玻璃柜台前，右手握着铅笔在练习本上写作业，左手压着纸页，蓝眼睛看向本子。耳机挂在颈间，旧收音机与卡带占据两侧。夕阳穿过货架，照亮她额前碎发和柜台上的尘埃。
data.action: 右手持铅笔写作业，左手压住练习本，耳机挂在颈间。
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada leans at the JUNK SHOP glass counter after school, writing homework with her right hand while her left holds the page flat. Headphones rest around her neck over the white shirt and navy cardigan. The horizontal medium view keeps old radios and cassette stacks on either side. Sunset filters through the shelving, illuminating forehead strands and counter dust, with layered radio shadows and subtle page reflections beneath the glass.
